div.head: V Atr 24
div.ab: ⁊ swicollice dæda ⁊ laðlice unlaga ascunige man swyðe, þæt is: false gewihta ⁊ woge gemeta ⁊ lease gewitnessa ⁊ fracodlice ficunga,
⁊ swicollice dæda ⁊ laðlice unlaga ascunige man swyþe, þæt is: false gewihta ⁊ woge gemeta ⁊ lease gewittnessa ⁊ fracodlice ficunga,
⁊ swicollice dæda ⁊ laðlice unlaga ascunige man swiðe, þæt is: falsa gewihta ⁊ woge gemeta ⁊ lease gewitnessa,
⁊ swicollice dæda ⁊ laðlice unlaga ascunige man swiðe, þæt is: falsa gewihta ⁊ woge gemeta ⁊ lease gewitnessa [⁊ fracodlice ficunga];
And swicollice dæda and laðlice unlaga ascunige man swyðe, þæt is: false gewihta and woge gemeta and lease gewitnessa and fracodlice ficunga;
Und betrügerische Handlungen und hässliche Rechtswidrigkeiten vermeide man sehr, nämlich falsche Gewichte und unrichtige Maasse und falsche Zeugnisse und schändliche Betrügereien,
And let deceitful deeds and hateful abuses be strictly shunned, namely false weights and wrong measures and lying witness and shameful frauds,
And deceitful deeds and hateful injustices shall be strictly avoided, namely, untrue weights and false measures and lying testimonies [and shameful frauds];
And deceitful deeds and hateful abuses are to be strictly shunned, namely, false weights and wrong measures and lying witnesses and shameful frauds,
And fraudulent deeds and hateful injustices are to be entirely rejected, that is: false weights and counterfeit measures and perjured testimony and shameful deceptions;

note.seg: fraudes subdolę sagt Paraphrast VI 28, 2. Gegen Hss. empfehlen Price-Thorpe, Schmid: fitunga, übs. [als fiht.]: ‘Gefechte’ (welches Wort die Wbb. zwar anführen, aber ohne Beleg). Es passt hier nicht zur Arglist. Angesichts der Wörter gefic, ficol, befician erregt ficung ‘Überlistung’ kein Bedenken

The paraphrast of VI 28, 2 says fraudes subdolę. Against the MSS, Price-Thorpe and Schmid recommend fitunga, translated [as fiht.]: ‘fights’ (a word which the dictionaries do list, but without attestation). Here it does not fit with craftiness. In view of the words gefic, ficol, befician, ficung ‘outwitting’ raises no difficulty
ficunga G, G₂ is emended to fitunga (cf. fit, strife) by Thorpe and Schmid, but retained by Liebermann in view of gefic, ficol, befician and translated ‘Betrügereien,’ i.e. frauds.
